```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  let slideIndex = 0;
  const slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".hero-slide"));
  const credit = document.querySelector(".hero-credit");

  const credits = [
    "Credit: BSF team",
    "Credit: BSF team A",
    "Credit: BSF teamB",
    "Credit: BSF team C",
    "Credit: ? (image DSCN3267)",
    "Credit: Prakash Basnet"
  ];

  // Randomize image order
  const order = slides.map((_, i) => i);

  for (let i = order.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [order[i], order[j]] = [order[j], order[i]];
  }

  function showSlide(position) {
    const imageIndex = order[position];

    // Change the image using your existing fade effect
    slides.forEach(slide => slide.classList.remove("active"));
    slides[imageIndex].classList.add("active");

    // Fade the credit out first
    credit.classList.remove("active");

    // Wait for the credit's fade-out before changing its text
    setTimeout(() => {
      credit.textContent = credits[imageIndex];

      // Allow the browser to apply opacity: 0 before fading in
      void credit.offsetWidth;
      credit.classList.add("active");
    }, 1500);
  }

  // Show the first randomized slide
  showSlide(slideIndex);

  // Change slides every 5 seconds
  if (slides.length > 1) {
    setInterval(() => {
      slideIndex = (slideIndex + 1) % slides.length;
      showSlide(slideIndex);
    }, 5000);
  }
});
</script>
```

# The Community Conservation Award

The Community Conservation Award provides funding to support locally led conservation and restoration initiatives that deliver meaningful benefits for both people and nature.

We support evidence-based projects with clearly defined objectives and measurable outcomes over a one- to two-year period. The award is particularly suited to initiatives that translate conservation research into practical impact, pilot new approaches, or provide start-up funding to achieve lasting change.

We are especially interested in projects that:

- Are led by, or developed in close partnership with, local communities

- Address clearly identified conservation challenges

- Demonstrate a strong evidence base and realistic pathway to impact

- Deliver tangible benefits for both biodiversity and human livelihoods

Funding is provided as a one-time award to support specific projects rather than ongoing operational expenses. Institutional overheads are not supported.

<a href="fundedprojects.qmd" class="card-link h2"> **Check out the projects we have funded so far** </a>

We welcome conversations with individuals, foundations, and organisations who share our commitment to evidence-based conservation and community-led environmental stewardship.
